ideal: A cloud thread reads every guard in CLAUDE.md, carries short instructions, and hands side work to read-only subagents on small models.

quality: Every guard sits where a thread reads it, instructions stay short, read-only agents cannot edit, and each thread opens a draft pull request.
speed: A thread opens its pull request within 10 minutes of its first commit, and a green one merges within a day.
consumption: Every subagent names a model, a thread idle past the one-hour cache is replaced, and tokens per merged pull request hold or fall.
